blocks.raw: <WikiMistakeList mistakes={[{"mistake":"PD 957 sets the minimum floor area for socialized housing at 22 sq.m.","fact":"BP 220 sets floor area standards, not PD 957. PD 957 regulates market-rate projects, not socialized housing."},{"mistake":"Economic housing under BP 220 has a minimum lot of 28 sq.m.","fact":"28 sq.m. is the minimum lot for socialized housing in infill sites. Economic housing minimum is 100 sq.m."},{"mistake":"Under RA 7279, occupants in danger areas may be evicted without any notice.","fact":"RA 7279 requires 30-day notice for all evictions, even in danger areas. What changes is that permanent resettlement is not required before clearing a danger zone."},{"mistake":"The Maceda Law entitles buyers who paid less than 2 years to a 50% refund.","fact":"The 50% refund applies only to buyers who paid 2 years or more. Buyers who paid less than 2 years receive only a grace period, not a refund."},{"mistake":"RA 7279 requires a 50-day notice before eviction.","fact":"RA 7279 requires 30-day written notice, not 50 days."},{"mistake":"PD 957 governs eviction of informal settlers.","fact":"PD 957 governs buyer protection in market-rate subdivisions and condominiums. Eviction is governed by RA 7279 (UDHA)."}]} />
